result.summary: Found 1 visible content defect: an invalid delivery-price value is displayed for one restaurant.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid numeric value instead of a real delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format the delivery-fee data before rendering. Show the correctly calculated fee, or a clear fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable” when no fee is present.
